basis: Cerence’s August 8 earnings release explicitly forecast consolidated revenue of $44 million to $50 million for the fiscal quarter ending September 30, 2024. The $50 million high end was 38.09% below Q4 FY2023 reported revenue of $80,764,000 and below the $76,725,800 threshold. This was the earliest explicit Q4 range found in the public disclosure search.

coverage.detail: February 6, Q1 results. Cerence forecast $60 million to $64 million for the March quarter and $355 million to $375 million for FY2024. Neither range covered Q4 alone.

May 9, Q2 results. Cerence reported $206.160 million of first-half revenue and forecast $66 million to $72 million for Q3 and $318 million to $332 million for FY2024. Those figures mathematically implied a Q4 ceiling of $59.840 million ($332 million less $206.160 million less $66 million). Cerence issued the two forecasts for Q3 and the full year, so the implied ceiling is a secondary observation.

May 9, Q2 call. Management’s filed remarks gave Q3 and annual revenue ranges. The public Q&A discussion of fourth-quarter pricing concerned average billings per car. The search of intervening conference remarks also found discussion of an annual run rate excluding legacy revenue at the May 21 TD Cowen event, without an explicit Q4 total-revenue forecast.
July 2. Cerence reaffirmed $66 million to $72 million specifically for the quarter ended June 30, its fiscal Q3.
August 8, Q3 investor presentation. The guidance table placed $44 million and $50 million in the Q4 FY2024 revenue columns and $321 million and $327 million in separate full-year columns.
October 7. Cerence reaffirmed $44 million to $50 million for the September quarter and expressly identified August 8 as the date it had announced that Q4 guidance.

November 21, actual results. The consolidated statements of operations show September-quarter total revenue of $54,805,000 in 2024 and $80,764,000 in 2023, a 32.14% decline. Actual revenue exceeded the guidance high end and still fell below the threshold.
The Q4 results presentation identifies $12.8 million of fixed-license revenue and $8.4 million of legacy Toyota-related revenue in Q4 FY2023. Both are included in the reported prior-year comparison.

publication_date_evidence: Cerence’s IR press-release archive lists the Q3 results release at 7:00 a.m. EDT on August 8, 2024. The release itself carries the same dateline and contains the Q4 forecast. [Issuer publication record](https://investors.cerence.com/news-events/press-releases?page=8)
